$note: Source-design oracle distilled from the two user-supplied Orion N5 style-reference images (2026-10-31). The reference images are third-party artwork and are not committed; this manifest records the measurable design facts they establish plus the review criteria that cannot be automated. Cross-engine parity is tested by parity-check.mjs and the image goldens; this oracle tests fidelity to the source design, which is a separate claim.

images.description: Orion N5 style board: grey/charcoal poster panels, mint-ice-cream background fields, orange data plates and vehicle livery, oversized grey display numerals, D35O technical framing.
Orion N5 orbital-data panel: mint ribbed background, dark ribbed housing, full-width orange data band, oversized grey 79 numeral, hex/orbit diagram, registration marks and barcode strips.

source.paletteBasis: Dominant-colour quantisation of the two reference images (see evidence/oracle-report.json).
source.compositionBasis: Quantised colour-family shares of the reference images; approximate design review bands, not pixel measurements.

paletteAnchors.role: large grey/charcoal poster and housing fields
big grey display type and industrial metal

composition.knownCurrentGap: The current dark HUD uses the Orion swatches but allocates most of every non-map frame to near-black; mint is confined to the map field and cream is used instead of mint on the progress dossier. The oracle audit records the exact shares; see evidence/visual-review.md.

requiredDevices: one oversized grey display wordmark or numeral per screen
orange data band or plate large enough to read as a field, not only a state accent
tight display tracking at large sizes
typography.knownCurrentGap: The largest current type is 40 px; the reference's defining big-grey display layer is absent.

requiredMotifs: thick dark housings and cutaway/chamfered panel frames
hex/orbit diagrams and crosshair registration marks
barcode/mission-code strips and technical specimen labels
graphicLanguage.knownCurrentGap: The map grid and hairline technical labels are present; the panel housings, hex/orbit diagrams, registration marks and display typography are absent.

claimBoundary.claimed: The three lanes are compared against each other for the eight captured 1280x800 states, with committed image goldens and a token-consumption gate, and are compared against the reference palette anchors.
notClaimed: fidelity to the reference composition, display typography or industrial graphic language
DPI/backend/OS coverage beyond the pinned macOS host

review.method: Agent visual inspection of the four state montages against the two reference images, plus quantised colour-family shares.
